left.title: Trump’s continued indolent response to Hurricane Maria is our worst fears about him come true
left.body: Almost 3,000 dead and he says, “We did a fantastic job.”
left.roundup: Puerto Rico's death toll from Hurricane Maria was raised on Tuesday from 64 to almost 3,000, with President Trump responding that his administration "did a fantastic job" and "put a lot of money and a lot of effort" into helping the disaster-stricken island.

center.title: Puerto Rico's death toll from Hurricane Maria raised to nearly 3,000
center.body: Puerto Rico’s official death toll from Hurricane Maria, the most powerful storm to hit the Caribbean island in almost a century, was raised on Tuesday from 64, a number widely discounted as far too low, to nearly 3,000, based on a study ordered by the governor of the U.S. territory.

right.title: Trump stands by disaster response in Puerto Rico: 'We did a fantastic job'
right.body: President Trump on Wednesday stood the administration’s response to Hurricane Maria last year in Puerto Rico, despite a new study raising the death toll to 2,975.
